description:
Title: LAN Party

You are planning a LAN party for 10 friends, so the first thing you have to do is to send invitations to these 10 friends.
Next, you have to find out which games they want to play.
As soon as you have received a list of games, you can appoint a date when the LAN party is going to happen.
If 8 or more people agree on this date, you are good to continue.
Else, you have to appoint another date, until 8 people are free to join you.
While you find a date, you can find out if you have all the games your guests want to play.
If some are missing, download them.
Next, you should find out how much beer your friends will require.
If you do not have enough, buy what's missing.
After that, you can enjoy the LAN party.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Invitation" name="LAN party invitation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GameList" name="List of desired games"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DateResponses" name="Date agreement responses"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LANParty">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Planner" name="LAN party planner" processRef="Process_LANParty"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="10 friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Invitation" name="Send invitations" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GameList" name="Provide desired games" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGameList" messageRef="Message_GameList"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DateResponses" name="Respond about date" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDateResponses" messageRef="Message_DateResponses"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_LANParty" name="LAN Party" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Plan" name="Planning begins"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends" messageRef="Message_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveGameList" name="Receive list of desired games" messageRef="Message_GameList"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelSplit" name="Work on date and games in parallel"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint a date"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDateResponses" name="Receive date agreement responses" messageRef="Message_DateResponses"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateAgreement" name="At least 8 people agree?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckGames" name="Check whether all desired games are available"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesAvailable" name="Are all desired games available?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DownloadGames" name="Download missing games"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesMerge" name="Continue after game check"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ParallelJoin" name="Date and games ready"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EstimateBeer" name="Find out how much beer friends require"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerEnough" name="Is there enough beer?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyBeer" name="Buy missing beer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerMerge" name="Continue after beer check"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyParty" name="Enjoy the LAN party"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Party" name="LAN party enjoyed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Plan" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_ReceiveGameList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveGameList" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDateResponses"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDateResponses" targetRef="Gateway_DateAgreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateAgreed" name="8 or more agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateAgreement" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">agreeingPeople >= 8</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateNotAgreed" name="Fewer than 8 agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateAgreement" targetRef="Task_AppointDate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">agreeingPeople < 8</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesAvailable" name="All games available" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">allDesiredGamesAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMissing" name="Some games are missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesAvailable" targetRef="Task_DownloadGames">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">someDesiredGamesMissing</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_DownloadGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMerge" targetRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_ParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_EstimateBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_EstimateBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerEnough"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerEnough" name="Enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerEnough" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">availableBeer >= requiredBeer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMissing" name="Not enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerEnough" targetRef="Task_BuyBeer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">availableBeer < requiredBeer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerMerge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyParty" targetRef="EndEvent_Party"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
